title: Core domain model: players, input snapshot, seeded RNG
description: Pure C# foundation in Barcade.Core. No engine dependencies so it is fully EditMode-testable. Follows unity-core and unity-testing skills.
acceptance_criteria: PlayerSlot type with exactly 4 fixed slots mapped to colors Rojo=0, Azul=1, Amarillo=2, Verde=3.
An immutable InputSnapshot value type holds stick direction (x,y floats) and action-button state (pressed/held/released) and carries no UnityEngine dependency.
ISeededRandom interface plus SeededRandom implementation wrapping System.Random; identical seed yields identical sequence.
EditMode tests cover slot/color mapping, snapshot immutability/derived helpers, and RNG determinism (same seed equals same sequence; different seeds differ).

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Done. Developer (tdd, test-first) added Barcade.Core player slots (Rojo/Azul/Amarillo/Verde 0-3), immutable InputSnapshot struct (engine-free, with Magnitude/Normalized/WithDeadZone/CardinalDirection), and ISeededRandom/SeededRandom. 45/45 EditMode tests green headless. Test commit d9f78f4, impl commit 3f08ac8. Reviewer APPROVED, no HIGH. LOW follow-ups (non-blocking): pin deadzone==threshold and exact-diagonal tie-break edge cases; one redundant immutability test.
